product.name: Stage Right by Monoprice Studio Egg Crate Acoustic Treatment Foam 1in Absorption Panels 12in x 12in Fire-Retardant 12-pack
product.description: Whether you're recording original music or doing a podcast, the difference between bad sound and a professional project can be the recording environment itself. Sound bounces and most untreated rooms will produce unwanted acoustic effects that easily deteriorate the quality of otherwise good recordings. Acoustic treatment corrects "bad sounding" rooms, improving the quality of your projects. Our acoustic panel packs are easy to install and will deliver a substantial improvement to your recordings with very little investment.Our panels can improve the acoustics of a room with as little as 20% coverage. With 12 pieces per box, a few boxes of our 12" x 12" panels will make any room or home studio recording ready. Attach the panels in a checkerboard fashion on the front and back walls of your room to minimize reflections and standing waves.Our water based Studio Foam Panel Adhesive (602614) is perfect for mounting and is sold separately. One tube will install about 16-24 square feet of acoustic panels.  1 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind this product with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30 day money back guarantee as well!
